tool_targets.description: Generate an image with GPT Image 2 through the Codex subscription using the Codex ImagesClient request contract.
Generate images synchronously with gpt-image-2 through the official OpenAI Images API. Custom width and height must each be divisible by 16; use output_format png or webp for transparency.

model.description: Exact image model selected by this target.

prompt.description: Describe the requested image, composition, content, and style.

n.description: Number of images to return; every image is retained.

quality.description: Image rendering quality; xhigh and max require a GPT Image 2.5 model.

size.description: Use auto or WIDTHxHEIGHT. Each edge must be divisible by 16 and at most 3840 px. Aspect ratio must stay within 1:3 to 3:1. Total pixels must be 655360 through 8294400; above 3686400 pixels is experimental.

background.description: Select transparency explicitly. Transparent output requires PNG or WebP; GPT Image 2 transparency remains in preview.

output_compression.description: JPEG or WebP compression percentage. Omit for PNG; the API default for supported formats is 100.

safety_identifier.description: Optional pseudonymous end-user identifier for provider safety monitoring.

stream.description: This target uses one synchronous JSON response.

extension_profile.summary: Official synchronous text-to-image generation with model-specific quality settings.
constraints: Each custom dimension must be a multiple of 16 pixels.
The longer-to-shorter edge ratio must not exceed 3:1.
Transparent backgrounds require PNG or WebP.
limitations: Transparent backgrounds are in preview for GPT Image 2.

sources.note: Codex subscription image generation follows the openai/codex ImagesClient request and response contract (codex-rs/codex-api/src/endpoint/images.rs, model gpt-image-2).

The official client always sends size auto and exposes no size argument; live probes on 2026-10-24 requesting 1024x1024 all returned 1536x1024, so size is pinned to auto (openai/codex#43965 reports the same).

The user explicitly fixes the public API inventory to eight undated GPT-5.6, GPT-6 and GPT-6.1 conversation models. All use Responses, file/image input, low/medium/high/xhigh/max reasoning, 1050000 context and 128000 maximum output. API filtering is entry-scoped; Codex subscription declarations remain unchanged.
Official Sol documentation supplies the shared 1050000 context, 128000 maximum output and reasoning levels adopted by the explicit user policy.

Authenticated read-only discovery on 2026-10-29 listed all eleven approved undated IDs. The endpoint reports identity and lifecycle fields only, so runtime membership intersects this exact allowlist; inference was not tested.

Official generation parameters define synchronous JSON requests, prompt length, n 1-10, output formats, conditional compression/transparency, safety identifier and per-model quality levels. GPT Image 2.5 adds xhigh/max; legacy style and response_format are excluded.
Custom dimensions require multiples of 16, edges no greater than 3840, aspect ratio within 1:3 and 3:1, and 655360-8294400 pixels. Outputs above 3686400 pixels are experimental.

On 2026-10-31 the user explicitly aligned the context declaration of all seven registered Codex subscription conversation models with the public API at 1050000 tokens. The previous 272000-token default must not be used as their model context ceiling. Session-level dynamic context-window selection and compaction remain independent and unchanged. Model inventory, output declarations and reasoning settings are unchanged. This supersedes the earlier unchanged-Codex scope note for context limits only; no live capacity test was performed.
